1.w: [“] And this [is] the law of the guilt offering: It [is] holy of holies.

2.w: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering, they shall slaughter the guilt offering; and he shall sprinkle its blood on the altar all around.

3.w: And he shall bring near all its fat from it, the fat tail, and the fat that is covering the entrails,

4.w: and the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them that [is] on the flanks, and the lobe of the liver above the kidneys—he shall remove it.

5.w: And the priest shall burn them on the altar, a fire offering to YHWH; it [is] a guilt offering.

6.w: Every male among the priests may eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place; it [is] holy of holies;

7.w: Like the sin offering, like the guilt offering; one law [is] for them. The priest who makes atonement with it, unto him it shall be.

8.w: And the priest who brings near a burnt offering of a man—the skin of the burnt offering that he has brought near, it is for the priest, for him.

9.w: And every grain offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is made in the pan or on a griddle,—it shall be for the priest who brings it near, for him.

10.w: And every grain offering mixed with the oil, or dry, it shall be for all sons of Aaron, each man like his brother.

11.w: And this [is] the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings that he shall bring near to YHWH:

12.w: If he brings it near for thanksgiving, then he shall bring it near with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with the oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with the oil, and well-mixed cakes of fine flour mixed with the oil.

13.w: Upon the cakes, he shall bring near leavened bread [as] his offering with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

14.w: And he shall bring near from it one [cake] from each offering, a contribution to YHWH. For the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings, for him it shall be.

15.w: And the flesh of the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offering, it shall be eaten on the day of its offering; he shall not leave from it until morning.

16.w: And if the sacrifice of his offering [is] a vow or a freewill offering, in the day of his bringing near his sacrifice, it shall be eaten; and on the next day the remainder of it may be eaten;

17.w: and the remainder from the flesh of the sacrifice in the third day must be burned in the fire.

18.w: And if from the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten at all in the third day, it shall not be accepted for him who is bringing it near, nor shall it be reckoned to him. It shall be an abomination, and the soul who eats from it shall bear his iniquity.

19.w: And the flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burned in the fire. And the flesh, every clean one shall eat flesh.

20.w: And the soul who eats the flesh from the sacrifice of the peace offerings that [is] to YHWH, and his uncleanness [is] on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

21.w: And if a soul touches any unclean thing—for uncleanness of man, or for an unclean animal, or for any unclean abomination—and he eats from the flesh of the sacrifice of the peace offerings that [is] to YHWH, then that soul shall be cut off from his people.”

22.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

23.w: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘Any fat of an ox, or sheep, or goat, you⁺ shall not eat.

24.w: And the fat of a carcass, and the fat of a torn thing, may be used for any work; and eating. you⁺ shall not eat it

25.w: For anyone eating fat from the beast of which he brings near, a fire offering to YHWH, then the soul eating shall be cut off from his people.

26.w: And any blood you⁺ shall not eat in any of your⁺ dwellings, of the bird and of the beast.

27.w: Any soul who eats any blood, then that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

28.w: And YHWH spoke to Moses, saying,

29.w: “Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, ‘He who is bringing near the sacrifice of his peace offerings to YHWH shall bring his offering to YHWH from the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

30.w: His hands shall bring fire offerings to YHWH; the fat upon the breast he shall bring with the breast to wave it [as] a wave offering before the face of YHWH.

31.w: And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar, and the breast shall be for Aaron and for his sons.

32.w: And the right thigh you⁺ shall give [as] a contribution to the priest from the sacrifices of your⁺ peace offerings.

33.w: The one from the sons of Aaron bringing near the blood of the peace offerings and the fat, to him shall be the right thigh for a portion.

34.w: For the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution I have taken from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons for an everlasting statute from the sons of Israel.’”

35.w: This [is] the anointing [portion] of Aaron and his sons from the fire offerings to YHWH on the day [Moses] presented them to minister as priests to YHWH,

36.w: which YHWH commanded to give to them on the day of his anointing them from the sons of Israel—an everlasting statute throughout their generations.

37.w: This [is] the law for the burnt offering, for the grain offering, and for the sin offering, and for the guilt offering, and for the ordination offerings, and for the sacrifice of the peace offerings,

38.w: that YHWH commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day of His commanding the sons of Israel to bring near their offerings to YHWH in the Wilderness of Sinai.
